products.name: Cisco SD-WAN
products.why: The Cisco overlay BT runs as managed SD-WAN — branches, cloud, and DIA on one fabric, and the WAN half of SASE.

products.name: Cisco Secure Access
products.why: Cisco’s SSE. Global Fabric peers into it as one of four SSE choices (Cisco, Fortinet, Netskope, Zscaler).

products.name: Webex Calling
products.why: Cloud calling BT sells as Webex Calling and as One Cloud Cisco (hosted in BT data centres).

products.name: Webex Meetings
products.why: Meetings half of the Cisco collaboration suite on the BT cloud collaboration page.

products.name: Webex
products.why: One of the UC platforms UC Edge routes onto GSIP, alongside Teams and Zoom.

products.name: Collaboration Devices
products.why: Rooms, boards, desks, and phones. Not named on BT’s public collaboration page. The Webex Meetings schedule already registers Room Kit, Board, and Desk series.
